house.description: Yearly reporting of trafficking data required.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; requiring yearly reporting of trafficking data; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 299A.785, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 299A.785, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Publication.
The commissioner shall gather and compile annually statistical data on the extent and nature of trafficking in Minnesota. The commissioner shall publish the data every [-two years-][+ year+]. This publication shall be available to the public and include, to the extent possible, the information to be collected in subdivision 1 and any other information the commissioner finds relevant to the issue of trafficking in Minnesota.
